meta.title: Kids Science Fair Sample — Paper Airplane Flight Lab Timeline
meta.subtitle: How Number One records hypotheses, stalled dead-end trials, verified balance lessons, and final winning flight data for the Three.js 3D runway

events.title: Attach & Log Starting Hypothesis
events.detail: agent.attach() initializes .numberone/ and agent.recordThinking() saves the nose-balance & wingtip hypothesis.

events.title: Trial #2 Tail-Weight Stall (Dead End)
events.detail: agent.recordFailedAttempt() logs tail pennies stalling at 1.4m so no classmate repeats the failed experiment.

events.title: Verified Balance & Wingtip Lessons
events.detail: agent.captureLesson() records nose paperclip balance (9.4m) and 1cm symmetrical wingtips (10.6m).

events.title: Winning Design Decision & Seal
events.detail: agent.recordDecision() preserves rationale & rejected folds; verifyIntegrity(false) confirms all 9 SHA-256 links.

events.title: 3D Flight Replay & Printable Report
events.detail: run.mjs exports data.json to Three.js (4 parabolic flight trajectories + time-travel scrubber) and builds a 9-chapter Science Fair Documentary.
